note: Memory cost per release, in MiB of VmRSS, measured with scripts/measure-cost. This file is the ledger the README chart (docs/static/images/cost-history.svg) is rendered from: scripts/measure-cost --record appends one entry per release, scripts/render-cost-chart redraws, and scripts/ci-check fails when the two disagree. Values are the release's own measurement on the reference machine (Linux, NVIDIA 620.70.06, Vulkan 1.4.363 loader, Godot 4.7.2); they are not comparable across driver stacks.
